rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image softness, but it speculates about early hatching/expanded appearance and comments on ICM/TE detail beyond what a single soft image can firmly support; limited discussion of zona features.
Thoroughly integrates age, endometriosis, AMH/FSH, BMI, prior cycle outcome, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to favorable and unfavorable factors; minor tension exists in questioning the reported stage while still accepting the lab grade.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer, lifestyle optimization, and review of stimulation/uterine factors, but inclusion of less standard suggestions such as gestrinone/danazol-like agents reduces guideline conformity.

Provides clear next steps for transfer, lifestyle changes, luteal support adherence, and future-cycle review including trigger timing, cavity assessment, and hydrosalpinx evaluation; useful though some recommendations are broader than necessary.
